notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Released
notes.content:
Updated from version 1.2.0 to 1.2.1.

[list]
[*] Increased player movement speed to match version 1.1.0.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Released
notes.content:
Updated from version 1.1.0 to 1.2.0.

[list]
[*] Added error logging. File [i]error.txt[/i] is automatically generated in the Cx6 application directory.
[*] Decreased bullet collision zone.
[*] Added, removed, and changed some launch messages.
[*] Increased scroll speed of launch messages.
[*] All assists now expire after [10, 15] seconds.
[*] Decreased bullet spawn frequency during Pattern Party modifier.
[*] Decreased player movement speed.
[*] Fixed bug where the player could be hit by the same bullet twice by exiting then re-entering its collision zone.
[*] Added progress bar as a visual indication of when the next modifier will activate.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Updated from version 1.0.1 to 1.1.0.

[list]
[*] Changed achievement 15 from "Score 100 points" to "Score 300 points."
[*] Changed achievement 18 from "Score 500 points" to "Score 1000 points."
[*] Changed achievement 19 from "Collect a mega jewel" to "Reach a streak of 20 patterns."
[*] Removed mega jewels.
[*] Added and removed some launch messages on the boot screen.
[*] Instead of scoring 1 point per second, the player now scores points equal to the current streak per second.
[*] Changed jewel despawn interval from [20, 25] to [15, 20] seconds.
[*] Fixed bug where the "x / 10" buffer display would get stuck at "10 / 10."
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
Updated from version 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where walls would fail to return to their starting position if the player deflects off them in quick succession.
[*] Reformatted leaderboard error messages.
[*] Fixed an occasional bullet not being deleted after the player dies.
[/list]
